# `/specify`

> Create a feature specification. Auto-detects the next feature if no argument given.

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/specify.md — do not edit -->

Creates the feature's git worktree and branch, then writes its spec with testable acceptance criteria.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/specify [feature-name]` |
| **Reads** | roadmap, `PRD.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `DESIGN.md`, every worktree's `specs/` |
| **Writes** | worktree `.claude/worktrees/NNN-name`, branch `feat/NNN-name`, `spec.md` |
| **Gates** | Stops if foundations are uncommitted on `main`; warns on unmet dependencies; you review the spec. |
| **Next** | `/clarify` (if markers) or `/plan` |
| **Tools** | `Bash(mkdir:*), Bash(ls:*), Bash(git:*), Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, EnterWorktree` |
